portfolio.title: Girls' TechDay
portfolio.collaborators: Usman N, Linnéa A & Lorin A
portfolio.reason: In November 2022 and 2024 I was part of "Teknikdag för tjejer" at BTH. The goal was to inspire young girls to pursue a career in technology. We created a workshop where they had to program a robot to navigate a maze.

portfolio.title: Staged²
portfolio.reason: Final project of the Virtual Environment course. The goal was to let the user experience stage fright in VR to simulate exposure therapy. The program has adjustable crowd density and 3 presentation environments: living room, classroom and theatre.

portfolio.title: Space Chase
portfolio.reason: Part of the Virtual Environment course, this project was created to learn about game development in Unity. Big focus was to create an immersive experience, focusing on story, characters and perspective. The player has to cooperate with their "partner in crime" to shoot down their enemies and escape their grasp.

portfolio.title: Smart Start
portfolio.collaborators: Andreas B, Adam S & Simon W
portfolio.reason: This workshop was created to educate external industry leaders about the basics of programming and electronics. The goal was to inspire them to think how technology could be implemneted in their field of work.

portfolio.title: Video Editing
portfolio.reason: Ambitious to learn about content creation, I took the task to record and edit our high school graduation ceremony. Today it serves as a memorial for the students and teachers who were part of the event.

portfolio.title: Snake Game
portfolio.reason: Originally created as part of a school assignment in 2019. It is written in XNA 4.0, which today is known as MonoGame. It has flaws for sure, but I am proud nonetheless. It is my first game with a fun and challenging gameplay loop.
